overall: Instructions are largely sound: 15 of 17 rows confirmed, both generalised and probed, with statutes, constitution, LII, opinions (decisionsList -> PDF) and Justia all reproducible. Two discrepancies: session-law chapter links now go to sos.ks.gov HTML text pages (plus printed Volume 1/2 PDFs), not enrolled-bill PDFs; and the rulebook expect string is broken by PDF hyphenation. Advance-sheet filenames sometimes carry '_1', so they must come from links. Regex gaps: three-decimal Supreme Court rules (7.041, 7.041A) are missed or truncated to 7.04 (wrong rule), and the prose form 'Section N of the Bill of Rights of the Kansas Constitution' is missed. WebFetch was gated on rules.ks.gov and eCourt; the script route covered both.
